column1: # R0 cost baseline at 33560b12 (epic #1678, ADR-0051 section 4.5), written by TestR0TPCHDifferential and
# TestR0CorpusCostBaseline with R0_COST_WRITE. RECORDED, NOT ASSERTED: plan_ms and stage_plan_ms are wall times on
# Per statement, from the stage graph PlanDistributed produces from D on the dag arm's configuration (3 workers):
#   stages, exchanges (exchange-*), scan_stages, selected_files and selected_bytes (the coordinator's scan-file list
#   after partition pruning), planned_tasks (Stage.Tasks as planned; 0 where dispatch decides), stage types,
# NOT exposed by the harness yet (owed by R2): dispatched tasks including broadcast replicas, retries and skew
#   splits; intermediate S3 PUT/GET counts and bytes; shuffle bytes; repeated expression evaluations; coordinator
#   peak memory; task bytes on the 500-column scan. SF1 not run (owed: an SF1 load on the in-process DAG harness
#   is outside a unit test's budget).
# The partition-pruning probe is asserted, not recorded: TestR0PartitionPruningThroughDerivedAlias
#   (2 files / 888 B -> 1 file / 452 B through a derived alias).
